messages:
support_jen: heads-up — multiple enterprise customers reporting streaming sessions cutting out mid-response in eu-west-1 this morning. Symptoms: client sees partial text, then immediate reconnects, sometimes getting duplicated tokens billed. Customer examples from Acme.ai + BetaHealth. I have sample req id: 0b7f8a2d. Escalating to SRE + runtime. :rotating_light:

leo-oncall: acknowledged. i'm pulling LB + gateway traces for eu-west. do we have rough timing windows and client SDK versions?

support_jen: first hits ~2026-03-15T09:12Z -> 09:22Z. clients are on our JS SDK 1.4.2 and a few on python 1.3.7. Repro steps from acme: open stream, send prompt (~800 tokens), server streams ~60% then connection closes, client reconnects and resumes but receives overlapping tokens.

ajay-runtime: looking at gateway logs for req 0b7f8a2d now. saw repeated WS CLOSE with code 1006 and then client reconnects. Also seeing a handful of "KV_CACHE_MISS" spikes on serving nodes around same time. pasting snippet:

```
2026-03-15T09:14:03Z gw-eu-3 INFO conn=0b7f8a2d ws_close=1006 reason="read: connection reset by peer"
2026-03-15T09:14:03Z runtime-eu-5 WARN stream=0b7f8a2d partial_frame=true last_chunk_size=842
2026-03-15T09:14:04Z runtime-eu-5 ERROR kvcache=miss keys=[session:0b7f8a2d]
2026-03-15T09:14:04Z gw-eu-2 INFO reconnect_attempt client_id=acme-01
```

maria-prod: billing flagged abnormal token count for Acme — looks like duplicates get charged when client reconnects and server replays from beginning. We need a short-term mitigation to avoid billing harm while we fix root cause.

leo-oncall: oncall plan: 1) stop serving new long-lived streams from the suspect pool (gw-eu-2/3 + runtime-eu-5) by shifting traffic; 2) enable prefix-dedup at gateway to avoid double-charges on reconnects; 3) gather heap/connection metrics. kicking off routing change now.

opsbot: route-shift job started: job_id=rs-1945-eu shift=30% -> fallback-pool (gw-eu-1, runtime-eu-1-2).

ajay-runtime: dispatching a quick config flag to gateways: `stream.dedup_on_reconnect=true` — this makes the gateway attach an ephemeral reconnect token and suppress replayed tokens for 30s after a reconnect. rolling to gw-eu-*. will be canaryed 10s then full.

leo-oncall: confirmed dedup flag applied on gw-eu-1/2/3. monitoring client reconnect counts and billed token deltas.

billing-bot: alert suppressed for Acme.ai (ticket 20031) while mitigation active. any confirmed overbilling incidents will be credited.

support_jen: shared mitigation and temporary guidance to customers: 1) upgrade SDK to 1.4.3 (contains reconnect id propagation), 2) add client-side idempotency token on stream start. customers asked for ETA on full fix.

ajay-runtime: initial hypothesis: a race between KV cache eviction and streaming continuation when KV keys are evicted under memory pressure -> runtime attempts to restart stream from last cached token, gateway interprets as new stream. Need to repro with load and KV churn. spinning up a repro job against runtime-eu-5 with a synthetic 800-token stream pattern.

leo-oncall: repro job started: repro-1945-1. also bumped `keepalive_interval` on ELB from 30s -> 60s to reduce mid-chunk connection resets caused by slow clients.

opsbot: deploy log: canary job repro-1945-1 started on runtime-eu-5, id=job-7734.

ajay-runtime: repro observed partial frames + KV eviction after ~35s under churn; confirmed race. workaround path: 1) prefer server-side prefix-cache fallback (avoid full replay), 2) keepalive bump, 3) dedup_on_reconnect at gateway. Planning patch to streaming runtime to honor reconnect tokens and resume from last committed token in a single-session semantics.

maria-prod: what's the rollback cost if we need to revert the config? we need communication to customers: status page update + scheduled maintenance if patch required.

leo-oncall: no rollback needed for config flags (we can toggle off), but runtime patch will need a canary with traffic shift and short maintenance window if it touches model-serving hot paths. for now status page: "Identified issue affecting streaming in EU-West; mitigations in place; token billing protections active; engineers investigating root cause."

support_jen: updated customers and posted interim status to status.redwood.ai/incidents/1945054321 — they appreciate the temporary credit policy.

ajay-runtime: final plan: 1) finish runtime patch to attach reconnect-id to internal session state + resume logic (PR up: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5143), 2) run canary in eu for 60m with 10% traffic, 3) if stable, roll to 100% over 30m. target ETA for full fix: 2026-03-15T14:00Z.

leo-oncall: monitoring looks stable after routing shift + dedup flag. reconnect rate down 78% in last 20m, duplicate billing events dropped to zero for affected customers. leaving thread open for final verification and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
